[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Nonrey''' was an important [[Armor/Legends|armor]] designer who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with an importance similar to that of doctor [[Nashiak Llalik]]. [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] lost track on Nonrey several years before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="AIR" />
